name: checkout-concierge
description: AI Growth & Agentic Commerce demo - conversation to explicitly authorised, Razorpay-verified purchase

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend/Web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend/Web run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:sdk
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend/Web run typecheck

workspaces_note: Deliberately NOT npm workspaces. The backend and the web client have separate lockfiles because they are separately deployable, and hoisting would put frontend packages in reach of the backend's import resolver - which is how a browser-only package ends up imported into a process that holds the service-role key. These scripts use --prefix instead.
